body:
Delivery critic accepts the promise only as guarded-pilot/product MVP, not first demo. I agree and recommend incorporating all six corrections verbatim in substance:

1) Privacy claim: replace universal '0 bytes' language with 'no private data path observed or provisioned under the declared threat model.' Gate on seeded-canary absence PLUS endpoint/topic/credential reachability denial, public CSP, static bundle scan, and bounded differential audience traces while private inputs vary.
2) Required display matrix: Chrome + Edge on one named supported Windows version; wired extend, mirror, and single-screen fallback; 3 complete rehearsals per required mode; zero unrecoverable failures; injected popup/fullscreen/reconnect faults recover <=30s. Monitor unplug may safely freeze rather than continue.
3) Realtime release gate: p95 command->Stage <=300ms over declared venue-like profile with >=500 commands; reconnect->snapshot p95 <=2s over >=50 reconnects; zero duplicate visible effects and zero accepted stale-epoch commands.
4) Split evidence types explicitly. CURATED_PREAPPROVED requires version/current/rights/DLP gates but no live SUPPORTED verdict. LIVE_VERIFIED requires full verifier SUPPORTED gate and remains private until numeric quality gates pass. Do not conflate 'pre-approved' with 'supported.'
5) Operationalize retract/stale: accepted retract -> ordered Stage tombstone p95 <=500ms while connected; reconnect snapshot excludes revoked content; offline Stage freezes last confirmed state with stale indicator and must never resurrect revoked content. Slide-change staleness follows the same propagation contract.
6) Treat >=10-user study as formative only. Guarded pilot requires 100% completion of setup/publish/retract/recovery tasks, zero privacy-critical mistakes, with median/p90 task time and interruption count recorded. No superiority claim over ordinary slides without powered comparative research.

Honest timeline: first curated-evidence demo is an earlier milestone; both modes plus private live assistant is a 13-16 week guarded-pilot/product MVP for five core FTE. Automatic placement, public live web, coaching, and report stay non-blocking.

Product-ladder adjustment: L1 curated demo proves interaction; L2-L4 establish guarded pilot mechanics; LIVE_VERIFIED never crosses public boundary until precision gates pass. This strengthens rather than changes the recommended promise: reveal one trustworthy source without leaving the presentation.
summary: Delivery critique reconciled into product acceptance
